title: Invite people to Bipe
summary: The user's personal invites to Bipe: how many are left, the invites not used yet, and the people who joined with one. Layout: one create button with the quota footer, then the pending list, then the joined list. Creating an invite opens invite-note. A pending row opens its card (invite-qr).

name.description: Invite.name: who the invite is for. Only the user sees it.

link.description: The link kept on this phone. Absent when the invite was made on another device: bipe_invites_other_device, no share.

joined.description: used only: the person who joined (Invite.joined_user_id).

appear.effect: GET /v1/me/invites. Drops the kept links of invites that are no longer pending.

openCard.effect: Opens invite-qr for this invite. Share, copy, rename and revoke live there.

rowMenu.effect: Long press on a pending row (iOS context menu, Android dropdown labelled bipe_invites_actions, also an accessibility action) gives the invite-qr actions without opening the card: bipe_app_share and bipe_app_copy when the link is on this phone, then bipe_invites_name_action and bipe_invites_revoke (destructive, confirmed). Joined rows have no menu.

openChat.effect: Opens the DM with the person who joined (bipe_invites_chat).

notes: API: GET and POST /v1/me/invites, PUT and DELETE /v1/me/invites/{inviteId}, GET /v1/me/invite-connections (api/openapi.yaml). A personal invite is single use and expires after 30 days.

Footer under the create button: bipe_invites_explainer; with 5 or fewer left, add bipe_invites_available; with none left, bipe_invites_none_left plus bipe_invites_next with nextAvailableAt. Bipe logic: BipeInviteQuota.footer (BipeKit BipeInviteCreator.swift); BipeInvitesPresenter (libraries/bipe invites).

The link and the note live only on this phone, keyed by invite id. The server stores the code as a hash and returns it once. Bipe logic: BipeInviteStore (BipeKit, keychain) and BipeInviteLinkStore (libraries/bipe invites, no-backup storage).

Join toast (parity invite-note): when GET /v1/me/invite-connections shows a new person who joined with the user's invite, the app shows bipe_invites_joined with the person's name once, and sends the waiting note (invite-note). This runs in the background at app start and on foreground, not only on this screen. Bipe logic: BipeInviteJoinNotifier and BipeInviteNoteSender (libraries/bipe invites); BipeInviteStore.seenJoinedInviteIDs (BipeKit).
Invite pairs are trusted: a DM invite from a pair joins without a chat request (ADR 0034). Bipe logic: BipeInvitePairs (libraries/bipe invites), BipeInviteStore.invitePairs (BipeKit).
This is an invite to Bipe, not to a group. Group invites are group-invite-members.
